skills_required.context_quote: Extensive experience developing high-concurrency services in Go, Python, or C++.
Design robust, highly available distributed architecture capable of handling millions of queries per second.
Deep knowledge of container orchestration (Kubernetes/Borg) and cloud infrastructure.
Familiarity with distributed NoSQL stores, transactional databases, and event streaming systems.
Drive unit, integration, stress testing, and ensure high test coverage.
Implement secure authentication, authorization, and data encryption practices.
Manage CI/CD pipelines and production observability (metrics, tracing, alerts).
Exceptional foundation in algorithms, concurrent programming, and complexity trade-offs.
Mentor junior engineers and collaborate cross-functionally with product managers and SREs.
Participate in agile planning, define sprint milestones, and meet delivery deadlines.
Understanding of hyper-scale platform dynamics, low latency requirements, and SLA management.
Eagerness to adopt emerging AI developer tools, new frameworks, and modern paradigms.

workplace_parameters.param_165_work_environment_pacing: High-ownership, rapid iterative sprints with rigorous code reviews
workplace_parameters.param_166_collaboration_breadth: Cross-timezone global teams across engineering, QA, and product
